title: Toadie connections
intro: Connections used to read declared API providers and consumers from Toadie. Everyone can view connection health; administrators configure credentials and refresh the cache.

field.backendUrlHint: Server-side GraphQL endpoint root. The browser never connects to this address.
field.browserUrlHint: User-facing Toadie address used for links.
field.apiKeyKeep: Leave blank to keep the stored API key

lastError: The last refresh failed ({{code}}). Previously synchronized usage remains visible.
deleteBody: “{{name}}” will be disconnected. Existing contract links remain visible as disconnected mappings.
deleteFailed: Could not delete the Toadie connection

validation.name: Name must be 1–100 characters
validation.url: Use an absolute http(s) URL without credentials, query or fragment
validation.refreshInterval: Use a whole number from 1 to 10080
validation.flattenDomains: Acknowledge that nested Toadie domains will be flattened

error.adminOnly: Only administrators can edit Toadie connections
error.conflict: The backend base URL cannot be changed; create a new connection for another Toadie instance
error.invalid: One or more fields are invalid
error.gone: This connection no longer exists — reload the page

registry.enabledHint: Allows administrators to explicitly import or link domains, systems and teams from this connection.
registry.optionalHint: Leave blank when this value is not mapped.
registry.parentRelationHint: Used only to show lost nesting in the preview; Covenant domains are flat.
registry.flattenWarning: Covenant stores a flat domain registry. Parent and child domains imported from Toadie become peers; the preview keeps their remote parent visible.
registry.flattenAcknowledge: I understand that Toadie domain nesting will be flattened
registry.title: Sync registry metadata from {{name}}
registry.intro: Select up to 50 records of one kind. Preview is required before Covenant imports new records, links existing records or updates linked metadata.
registry.orderHint: Synchronize domains before systems. A system follows its linked Toadie domain; a fallback is used only when the remote system has no domain relation.
registry.fallbackRequired: Choose a fallback only for a system without a remote domain.
registry.selectionLimit: You can preview at most 50 records at once.
registry.previewFailed: Could not prepare the registry preview
registry.stalePreview: The source or local registry changed. Prepare a fresh preview before applying.
registry.noCandidates: No Toadie records match this view
registry.cannotApply: Resolve the preview issues before applying these changes.
registry.notConfigured: Configure registry metadata mapping on this connection before synchronizing.
registry.nonCurrent: Registry synchronization requires a current complete Toadie snapshot.

issue.REMOTE_ALREADY_LINKED: This Toadie record is already linked
issue.LOCAL_ALREADY_LINKED: This Covenant record is already linked
issue.LOCAL_NOT_FOUND: The selected Covenant record no longer exists
issue.NAME_CONFLICT: The source name conflicts with an existing record
issue.DOMAIN_UNMAPPED: The remote domain exists but is not linked to a Covenant domain
issue.DOMAIN_NOT_FOUND: The selected fallback domain no longer exists
issue.SOURCE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: This connection has reached the 5,000 linked registry record limit

registry.metadataLocked: The name and source-managed fields are synchronized from Toadie.
registry.descriptionLocal: The description remains locally editable because no source description property is mapped.
registry.detachBody: Current metadata and local relationships will be preserved. Source-managed fields become editable and future syncs will not update this record.
registry.detachFailed: Could not detach the Toadie source

usage.title: Usage from Toadie
usage.intro: Declared providers and consumers from the latest cached Toadie data.
usage.saveFailed: Could not save the Toadie links
usage.noLinks: This contract is not linked to a Toadie API
